case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and the quality commitment is where that starts. Our options put a firm quality commitment and a clear unit price on the table, so your team knows exactly what it is signing.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve. Its quality commitment is far tighter than the one in your Angebot, and it carries no chargeback per complaint, which fits the quality record and the price history above.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Beyond the options, we will act as a reference customer for your other clients, share our rolling forecast with you every quarter, approve your invoices within days of receipt, and name you a preferred supplier for this part family.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Thanks for the options - getting our invoices approved within days is a big plus for us right now, so we definitely want to make this work. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. 

I can drop our price to 46.00 EUR for this package, which is a fair move from our side. Right now, our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.body:

You said you cannot give up margin right now, and the quality commitment is where our options answer that. A firm commitment to low defects with a clear chargeback gives your team a plain, steady basis for this work.

Thank you for confirming that the quality record and the price history hold. That is the ground we are building on.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 150.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.52.
Option B: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.48.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 300.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.57.

Option A is the package we can approve. It pairs your quality commitment with a moderate chargeback and a unit price that reflects that balance.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
